svg.title: Scenario 3, shared + exclusive: who runs where
svg.desc: VM A's vCPUs 0 and 1 are on CPUs 0 and 4. VM B's vCPUs 0 and 1 are on CPUs 1 and 5. CPUs 2, 6, 3 and 7 are shared by vCPU 2, the emulator thread and the IO thread of both VMs.
